table.name: customers
table.purpose: Customer master table: one row per customer, with a segment code and preferred billing currency. Referenced by transactions_1k (customer id) and yearmonth (likely a customer-period table keyed by customer).

col_001.name: customer_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique customer identifier (integer). Referenced by transactions_1k.col_004 (the customer on each transaction) and by yearmonth.col_001 (per-customer monthly records).

col_002.name: customer_segment
col_002.description: Customer segment code with three levels: SME (small/medium enterprise, 26763), LAM (3658), KAM (2040). Likely 'Small/Medium', 'Large Account Manager' and 'Key Account Manager' segments, i.e. small, large and key accounts. Exact expansion of the acronyms is not certain.

col_003.name: currency
col_003.description: Customer's billing currency: CZK (Czech koruna, 30459) or EUR (2002).

table.name: gasstations
table.purpose: Directory of gas stations: each row is one gas station with an ID, its chain/brand, country, and market segment. Referenced by transactions_1k (per-station sales records).

col_001.name: station_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier of a gas station (range 44-5772). Referenced by transactions_1k.col_006, which records sales at each station.

col_002.name: chain_id
col_002.description: Identifier of the gas station chain/brand; references products.col_001 and transactions_1k.col_001 (many stations per chain, 233 distinct values). The exact meaning of the referenced tables is unclear, so 'chain/brand' is the most plausible reading; alternatively it could be a parent company or operator group.

col_003.name: country_code
col_003.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code: CZE (Czech Republic, 4836 stations) or SVK (Slovakia, 880 stations).

col_004.name: segment
col_004.description: Market segment / positioning of the station's fuel offering: Premium, Value for money, Discount, Noname, or Other.

table.name: products
table.purpose: Product/service catalog for a fuel-card system: each row is a product or service item (fuels, car-wash, tolls, fees, spare parts, etc.) that can appear on fuel-card transactions. Czech labels suggest a Czech fuel-card issuer (e.g. CCS/MOL-style).

col_001.name: product_id
col_001.description: Primary key: unique numeric product identifier (1-630, 591 distinct values). Referenced by transaction columns in transactions_1k and by gasstations.col_002.

col_002.name: product_name
col_002.description: Human-readable product/service name, mostly Czech (e.g. 'Katalyzátor' = catalytic converter, 'Potraviny' = groceries, 'Servisní poplatek' = service fee, 'Ostatní zboží' = other goods). Covers fuels, additives (AdBlue), tolls (Toll DEU/Austria), fees, and card-issuing services. Slight duplicates (529 distinct of 591) suggest minor naming inconsistencies.

table.name: transactions_1k
table.purpose: Point-of-sale fuel purchase transactions at gas stations: one row per purchase, recording when it happened, which customer/card made it, at which station, of which product, in what quantity, and at what total price.

col_002.name: transaction_date
col_002.description: Date of the transaction (stored as text, format YYYY-MM-DD); all rows fall in 2012-08-23 to 2012-08-26.

col_003.name: transaction_time
col_003.description: Time of day of the transaction (stored as text, format HH:MM:00).

col_004.name: customer_id
col_004.description: Reference to customers.col_001; identifies the customer who made the purchase.

col_005.name: card_id
col_005.description: Loyalty/payment card number used for the transaction. Not a join key to any known table; values are large 5-6 digit numbers, mostly unique per transaction. Could alternatively be a customer card identifier, but no table links it.

col_006.name: gasstation_id
col_006.description: Reference to gasstations.col_001; identifies the gas station where the purchase occurred.

col_007.name: product_id
col_007.description: Reference to products.col_001; identifies the product purchased (fuel type or shop item).

col_008.name: amount
col_008.description: Quantity purchased (e.g., liters of fuel or units of product). It joins to products.col_001 only because product IDs and small quantities overlap numerically; the value distribution (0-264, median 19) fits a quantity, not a product reference. Units unconfirmed.

col_009.name: total_price
col_009.description: Total price of the transaction in currency units (e.g., euros); consistent with amount x unit price (max 5762.49, median ~354).

table.name: customer_monthly_spend
table.purpose: Aggregated spending per customer per month (YYYYMM), likely derived from the transactions tables; col_003 is the total amount spent by that customer in that month, with negative values indicating refunds/credits.

col_001.name: customer_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the customer; references customers.col_001 (many-to-one). Each customer appears in many rows (one per month).

col_002.name: year_month
col_002.description: Month identifier in YYYYMM format (values 201112 through 201311, i.e. Dec 2011 to Nov 2013). Stored as VARCHAR but numeric.

col_003.name: total_spend
col_003.description: Total amount spent by the customer in that month (currency, likely euros given the gas-station context). Mostly positive; negative values (min -582092.86) suggest refunds, reversals or credit adjustments. Tentative: could be a balance/loyalty-points amount instead of spend, but the distribution and transaction context support a monthly spend total.
